No current British Virgin Islands or Australian government source was found that maps an ordinary Australian passport to a short-visitor route; no waiver is inferred from omission.
Current Burkina Faso material does not establish ordinary Australian-passport eligibility and actual electronic or mission-visa issuance timing.
